tested_scope: Exactly one child root already processed=true with exactly two durable child events and one parent completion identity C. One append(C) attempt has unknown acknowledgment. Durable observation after that attempt is constrained to C absent or C present exactly once. Resume uses membership(C) as the only decision predicate.
mechanism: On resume, read durable parent completion identities. If C is present exactly once, treat the ambiguous append as committed and do not append. If C is absent, append C once, then read durable parent completion identities and require C present exactly once. No retry is issued merely because the original acknowledgment was lost.

branch_checks.final_state: C present exactly once after durable readback

inference: For this exact single-writer repository-visible identity state machine, acknowledgment loss does not require replaying the append blindly. Durable membership distinguishes already-committed from not-committed state and deterministically converges to exactly one completion record.
scope_guard: This pass is limited to one single-writer completion-record identity with durable atomic append visibility and exact membership observation. It does not establish parent processed-state safety, concurrent-writer correctness, torn/corrupt writes, identity collisions, multiple child completions, ordering-sensitive parent aggregation, external non-idempotent side effects, hostile-size behavior, or global Phase-1 closure.
